run_step_optimization: run a single optimization step with CLIP encoding, gradient backpropagation, and learning rate annealing
run_population_evolution_step: run a genetic algorithm evolution step using microbial competition or evolutionary strategies on the population
run_evaluation: run an evaluation step to compute cosine similarity losses between generated images and CLIP text features
